ops.body: - Outing journey step 1 (OJ1-OJ40, decision 0208) left for later: the near towns as shortcuts (OJ8, with step 2: it loads the gazetteer on opening the page); a press and hold on the map to set a destination; "Include chains" behind the sheet's pull-up (OJ16); attractions from the places archive (the tiles' own only); a check for the capture stack on the page (OJ39); the cold find and the UI review of the new page (decisions 0167, 0145); the opened journey's sheet covers part of its route on a small screen; steps 2 (the towns between, a line on each, no cap, variety) and 3 (the session's bar) and the road engine slice (0208)

- The one machine (decision 0209, OJ41-OJ46) left for later: the session carrying a journey from town to town (step 3; Start begins the first town's chapter); "Leave this town out" (OJ26); the atlas's own words and street names in a town's line (OJ23: the chips' words today); the setting for how many towns one look reads (eight, `AREA_RULES.readMax`; decision 0208); marks per kind and town outlines on the page's map (the map component, two platforms); the camera's fit under the sheet; what makes a shop "been there" (the owner's call; shops are not told new from known); a second cold find and the UI review of the page (decisions 0167, 0145); C5 of the first cold find (which row a swap changed); a journey toward a far place run against real towns (the test world's hold nothing)

- Visited from the trace (OJ47, decision 0210) reads the walked fixes of the newest thirty outings near an area each time the area is read (n: up to 30 outings of 1k-30k fixes, once per area read, off the frame; not measured): an older visit is missed, gap fills and driven stops are not read, and a kept index of where traces have been would be a cache with its own slice; the stores pack is merged onto chronicles-data's main on a branch and waits on the owner to merge and publish, after which the app takes the contract's pinned copy again (v5)
  the stores pack was merged to chronicles-data's main on Nov 17 (the owner's go-ahead, efa45d9); its first build has to finish the OpenStreetMap download, which no run there has yet done, before a pack is published

- Outing journey audit (Nov 17), deferred: reads that no longer matter run to their end, since a read takes no stop signal (audit 12: at most one extra area read after a change of reach or destination); planning runs in render over each read's street graph, now built once per read but still routed on the JS thread at every chip (audit 5's remainder; n: up to 8 areas of about 15k segments, 4 journeys; not measured); new-first misses a town whose name differs between the gazetteer and the area's row, and the outing being recorded now has no rows yet (audit 19); a journey across the antimeridian drops the towns between (audit 20); `listFinds` and the settings are read for each area of a look and again at each arrival (audit 21: at most eight a look); the capture stack on the page while a session records has no picture or check (audit 24, OJ39); "Include chains" is a checkbox, not a switch (audit 30)

- A journey carried by the session (decision 0211, OJ48-OJ51), left for later: no check in a browser of the way on foot within reach of a town (OJ30), of a town let go by driving past (unit only), of "Leave this town out" or of the line between towns (OJ26, OJ51), since the test world holds one town with anything in it; a journey resumed in a later session, kept or shared; `sessionTrace` reads the whole trace once when the walk screen opens (n: up to 30k fixes, thinned to a tenth); "Pass by" and putting the plan away last only while the screen does, by design (nothing stores reached or passed)

- Outing journey, second audit (Nov 18), deferred: a stop's position reaches the maps app through a failed route's "Open in Maps" banner and through "When I get there", which saves a stop as Navigate's destination (audit 40; OJ29 asks for the town's point); a journey's way, once tapped, may still say "Off your route" (audit 51, unconfirmed); a long journey scrolls in a sheet that opens at three quarters of the screen (audit 57); beside the capture stack the sheet is narrowed for its whole height (audit 58); Start does not say it records a drive and the walk screen's glyph is footprints (audit 60, with the session's name, decision 0207); no browser check of "Show the way" within reach of a town, of a town let go by drifting, or of the line between towns: the test world's towns are a drive apart and its map tiles are blank

- A moment's own place (MC18, decision 0212), left for later: between towns the context line can only say the state, since a road's name or a county needs the map read there (the street cache holds only where streets were derived); a session still open has no areas until Stop, so its moments name no town until then; `contextFor` reads every outing's area rows once per batch (n: outings times the areas each crossed, a few thousand rows over years; a per-outing read would need a new `Db` method and its contract case); `MomentView.place` in `resurface/views.ts` still carries the outing's one name and nothing reads it

- The drive in the outing, part 1 (start in the car, DO5-DO8; decision 0216), left for later: a pressed spot past what can be walked still offers "When I get there" alone (it has no name to head toward); the tiles' own buttons are unchanged ("Set as destination" for a far place, "Walk there" otherwise); between 2 and 10 km "Start now" still routes the way on foot, as "Walk now" did, though the stretch may be driven; DO9 (the title of an outing begun in the car) and DO10 have no test of their own (rides R8, and by construction); every other "walk" in the app's words waits for 0207's renaming slice; parts 2 to 4 (the drive in the replay, places from the road, hands-free capture) are not started.

- The road engine, step 1 (RE4-RE13, decisions 0213 and 0214), left for later: steps 2 to 4 (the tiles' source and the road on the outing page; guiding with "Drive there"; spoken turns and the lock screen); a road's end is joined to another road's point within 10 m, not to the nearest place along its line, so a side road meeting a simplified main road between its points may stay apart (about 1.4% of the measured road length is outside the largest part); links are flagged and not yet costed or named differently; no cache of roads (the graph is built again for each plan: 76 ms for nine tiles on a desktop, unmeasured for sixty or on a phone); the road pack from chronicles-data; the live tile host's roads have never been read

- The road engine, step 2 (RE1, RE2, RE8, RE15-RE19, RE30), left for later: the towns a journey may take are still those near the straight line, not near the road found (RE14, and with it RE18's "a journey whose towns come from the road is added"): it needs a second set of areas read and planned beside the first, and a card added under the reader's eye; the graph is built and the tiles decoded on the page in turns, not in a worker (a corridor of sixty tiles is unmeasured: nine built in 76 ms on a desktop); a journey with no named place (a reach) draws its towns joined straight and says nothing by road, since RE8 reads roads only for a place picked; a road answer is held per page and found again each time the page opens; the session's bar still says a town is "away" in a straight line (step 3); a way that is road for some stretches and straight for others is drawn but its length is not said "by road"; the e2e checks the line handed to the map by its count of points, not by what is painted.

- The road engine, step 3 (guiding: RE3, RE19-RE24, RE26-RE28), left for later: a turn has no road name or number (RE20, RE21: the engine reads no names; the tiles' name layer is thin at z12); a roundabout is not known as one (the tiles do not mark them), so it is read as the turns it is made of and no exit is said by its place (RE21's one ordinal is unused); finding the way again reads its whole corridor when it is not inside the one held, not only the tiles the graph lacks (RE22); the road being driven is not drawn on the session's map, only the turn is said; the screen's position follows a drive only once the trace reads it as a ride (20 s of fast fixes, R1), so the first turn can lag that long after setting off, and the one-time statement stays up until then; the wait before finding again is 400 m driven off the way and "off the way" is 120 m, neither tried on a real road; guiding is offered on the web only (a phone waits for spoken turns, decision 0214), so RE25's speech and its mute, and RE33, are step 4; "On this road" with what is left of it is said after the last turn, a line the spec did not name.

- The road engine, step 4 (spoken turns, RE25; decision 0215), left for later: nothing is spoken with the phone locked or the app behind another, since the screen's position is read only while the app is in front (`useLiveTrace` skips while not active), so RE33 is not met: it needs the drive step and the speech run from the background location task; a turn found again after leaving the way may be spoken a second time (it is told apart by where it is along the way, which changes with the new way); the voice, its language and its rate are the phone's defaults, and speech does not lower or pause other audio by any choice of ours; "End" and the mute are taps on a moving screen.

- The road engine's audit (Nov 18), deferred: the session's bar wraps its actions to a second row at 390 px and a third at 320 (audit 19: a menu for "Pass by" changes the bar's shape, the owner's); the way starts at the junction nearest the fix whatever the carriageway or heading, so on a divided road it can begin against the drive (20); nothing guides while the session's screen is minimised inside the app, and a turn is spoken again on return (21); the one-time statement shows to someone already moving and a turn can be spoken beside it (22); someone who starts from Explore's far card never reads that the way keeps to the roads through the towns (26); "Undo" on the bar names nothing and turns back into "Pass by" after 300 m (27); the page says "by road" and the bar "away" for one place, 11.5 km on a card is 11 km on the bar, and the bar's Open in Maps has no leaves-the-app glyph (30); "Pass by" on a one-town plan (31); the mute's state is only its words, and the plan's row still says a switch in options (32); the journey's footer explains its buttons in two lines, small text controls sit close together on the page, and the far card's Open in Maps is 42 px tall (33); Android's `geo:` link carries no travel mode, RE29's bound is a count of junctions and not a time, and no test drives a muted turn (35); one synchronous graph build per corridor, per card (9, in part). From the drive in the outing's: a start held up past two minutes loses its plan (3); a far place reached from a row of another area's card gets the ordinary question and "Start now" then routes on foot (4).

- [ ] **Do:** on a phone, on Explore, tap "Plan an outing"; tap the field "Where to?", type a town an hour's drive away and pick it; switch chips on and off; swipe the journey cards; tap "See this journey"; then go back, close, open again and tap "Nowhere in particular". **Expect:** the page is the map with the field over it and a sheet below; the town shows with its distance "away"; the map moves to it; up to three cards scroll sideways one at a time and the map draws the one in view; a far town offers "When I get there" beside Start (alone past 10 km); around here the journey starts at once; the keyboard never covers the search results (OJ1-OJ4, OJ7, OJ9, OJ17)

- [ ] **Do:** on a phone with data on, open "Plan an outing" somewhere with shops and sights about; read the journeys it proposes at once; switch on chips of two kinds (say Thrifting and History); tap "5 km", then "15 km"; open a journey, tap "Another like this" twice, tap a town's "Open in Maps"; fold the sheet with "Show the map"; then pick a town an hour away in "Where to?". **Expect:** journeys appear without a destination; a mixed "A bit of each" leads when the chips span kinds; a wider reach says it is reading the towns, then lists a chapter for each town that has something, towns you have not walked in first; Another like this changes the stops, then says there are no others; Maps opens at the town; the folded sheet shows the map; toward a far town the towns between are chapters in order; nothing stalls the page while towns are read (OJ20, OJ41-OJ46)

- [ ] **Do:** on a phone with a few recorded outings in one town, open "Plan an outing" there with Thrifting or Antiques on, and note the stops; walk up to one of the shops on a recorded outing, stop it, and open the page again from the same spot. **Expect:** the shop you walked up to is no longer among the first stops offered while others remain; a shop you only drove past still is; the page opens without a pause you can feel (OJ42, OJ47)

- [ ] **Do:** on a phone, open "Plan an outing" with a session recording and with none; swipe the journey cards; press the hardware Back with the search open, with a journey opened, and on the list; turn the network off and tap a wider reach, then "Try again" with it back on; tap a town's "Open in Maps" with no maps app able to open it; start a journey whose first chapter is one stop, both with Start and with "When I get there". **Expect:** the capture stack is on the page, one tap each, never under the sheet or its pinned cards; the cards snap one at a time and the dots follow; Back closes the search, then the journey, then the page; a failed read says so and Try again reads it; Maps failing says a line; a single stop is an ordinary destination with no path, and the walk screen names it once on arrival (OJ24, OJ37, OJ39, audit 7, 8, 13-16)

- [ ] **Do:** on a phone, plan a journey toward a town an hour's drive away with two or more towns in it; leave one town out on the page; tap Start at home and drive; watch the walk screen in each of these: before the first town, in it on foot, driving past the second without stopping, after "Pass by", after locking the phone for the drive, after killing and reopening the app mid-drive; then Stop. **Expect:** the session records from Start, the drive included; the bar names the town ahead with its distance in two rows that never cover the capture stack; "Open in Maps" opens the town in the maps app; within about 2 km of a town the way on foot through its stops appears once and its stops are named only on arrival; a town left behind or driven past is never named again and nothing is marked done; the plan survives the app being killed; after Stop, the next session shows no bar (OJ28-OJ31, OJ33, OJ48, OJ49)

- [ ] **Do:** on a phone on a real drive with a two-town journey: after Start, turn off the planned way and drive 10 km another way; come back and drive into the first town; tap "Show the way", walk some of it, tap End, minimise the session and return; tap "Pass by", then Undo, then "Pass by" again and drive on; open the planning page while recording and leave a town out, then Undo. **Expect:** the white bar reads "Toward <town>. <distance> away." on one or two lines with both controls on one row at any phone width; drifting far lets the town go with nothing said; in the town it reads "<town> is here." and nothing is routed until "Show the way"; after End nothing routes again by itself, on return too; a town passed by does not come back after the app is reopened; with no town ahead the bar is gone and nothing says the journey is over; the capture buttons are never covered on either screen (OJ29-OJ31, OJ33, OJ39, audit 32-49)

- The road on the outing page (RE1, RE2, RE15-RE19; `roads/tilesSource.ts`, `roads/service.ts`, `outing/useJourney.ts`): reading a strip of z12 tiles, decoding them and building the graph on the JS thread in turns (no worker on native) has never run on a phone: how long sixty tiles hold the screen is unknown; the road drawn through the `alternates` layer; Open in Maps asking for driving directions (`dirflg=d`, Android's `geo:` chooser first and Google's driving link after).

- Guiding a drive (RE19-RE28; `roads/turns.ts`, `roads/drive.ts`, `roads/useDrive.ts`, `outing/useJourneyBar.ts`, the bar in `src/app/walk.tsx`): offered on phones since step 4 (decision 0215) and never run on one: the bar's turn while moving, the road drawn ahead on the native map's `alternates` layer, the way found again off the road, the guiding found again after the app is reopened, how a turn reads at a glance in a car, and the bar's state set during render on every fix.

- Spoken turns and guiding on a phone (RE25, RE33; decision 0215; `roads/speech.ts` over `expo-speech`, `roads/useDrive.ts`): "Drive there" is now offered on iOS and Android and has never run on either: whether a turn is heard at all, over music or a call, through CarPlay or Bluetooth; whether it is spoken once; the mute; and that nothing is spoken once the phone is locked (known: the position is read only in front).

- [ ] **Do:** on a phone, start an outing toward a town a drive away, tap "Drive there", then lock the phone (and, on another drive, switch to another app) and drive through two turns. **Expect:** each turn is spoken once as it nears; no notification of the app's own appears; nothing more is spoken after "End directions", at the town, or after Stop. Today nothing is spoken once the phone is locked: the position is read only while the app is in front (RE33)

ops.body: - The second audit changed three things the plan had decided, each within the vision's own lines but yours to overrule: the way on foot in a town is offered ("Show the way") and no longer begins by itself; the bar's close is gone, and "Pass by" on the last town puts the plan away; a town you drift well away from is let go without a tap. (audits 33, 45, 46)

ops.intro: The steward's questions from the road engine's audit that only the owner answers; nothing here is built or decided.

ops.body: - Guiding still needs the screen (road-engine audit 23): the voice says the turn and never how far, so two junctions close together are told apart only by looking; nothing is spoken with the phone locked; muted, or in a browser with no voice, it is look-only. Either the spoken turn carries the distance, or the shown turn is a second exception to "Nothing on a ride asks for a look or a tap".

- A ride now has a bar with controls (road-engine audit 24): after "Start now" for a far place, or with a journey carried, the session shows "Toward <town>" with Drive there, Open in Maps and Pass by, where DO8 and DO26 say a ride adds nothing to the screen. Either the bar is the town's line alone while moving, or DO8 and DO26 name it.

- DO1 against arrival (road-engine audit 25): "no arrival ever offers anything", yet with the town at hand guiding ends by itself and the bar offers "Show the way" (OJ30, RE24). Which gives way, or whether DO1 names these as its two exceptions.
